title: Approval bound to the artifact
description: The executor's amber plate is cut from the keel of the crate the reviewer approved; swap in a revision with the same label and run the executor.
initialCaption: The reviewer approved crate A; the executor’s amber plate is cut from A’s keel.
interactionHint: Drag to look around · scroll to zoom · click the gate to look through it
fallback: Crates A and B carry the same “checkout” label, but their keels differ. The executor's plate is cut from A's keel, so B cannot pass until the reviewer inspects B and the plate is recut.
